main_text.l: Ampliffimo, confultis. prudentis.q; viro Dn. Vincentio Mullero inclytæ reipub. Bremensis Syndico dignissimo;
Reverendo item, pietate atq; eruditione præcellenti viro Dn. Johanni Arcerio reformatæ ecclesiæ Althenaviensis ministro vigilantissimo;
Honestissimis, virtute ac integritate præstantissimis, doctisq; viris
Dn. Ludovico de Behout civi Hamburgensi, ac confistorii ecclesiæ orthodoxæ Althenaviensis seniori,
Dn. Johanni Winkelio civi Bremensi spectatis.
Dominis ac mæcenatibus omni observnntia genere perpetuum profequendis hasce de unitate ecclesiæ theses in grati animi τεκμήριον, inscribit & offert,

page.notes: The ornament line at the top is a decorative border and is not transcribed. Some words in the second and third lines are italic, and the italics are marked only where clearly visible. The Greek word τεκμήριον is as I read it and may be imperfect. The name "Dn. Johanni Winkelio" and the abbreviated words are as printed.
